guild_district = {
	primary_building = pb_guild_01
	
	#East Asia
	background = {
		trigger = {
			culture ?= {
				has_graphical_east_asia_culture_group_trigger = yes
			}
		}
		reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/gdp_artisans_street_asia_crowd.dds"
	}

	#MENA
	background = {
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				culture ?= { has_building_gfx = iranian_building_gfx }
				culture ?= { has_building_gfx = mena_building_gfx }
				culture ?= { has_building_gfx = african_building_gfx }

		}

		}

	}

	#MENA

			OR = {

			culture ?= { has_graphical_norse_culture_group_trigger = yes }
		}

	#Western Fallback

		reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/feast.dds"
	}

	can_be_replaced = yes

	is_enabled = {
		scope:holder = {
			OR = { # Elf Destiny: Ascended Tribal and the Aeluran Order count as tribal here
				government_has_flag = government_is_tribal
				government_has_flag = government_is_advanced_tribal
				government_has_flag = government_is_aeluran_order
			}
		}

			OR = { # Elf Destiny: Ascended Tribal and the Aeluran Order count as tribal here

				government_has_flag = government_is_advanced_tribal

tribal_military_district = {
	primary_building = pb_tribal_military_01
	
	#Steppe
	background = {
		trigger = {
			culture ?= { has_graphical_steppe_culture_group_trigger = yes }
		}
		reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/mpo_tent_interior_mongol.dds"
	}

	#Fallback
	background = {
		reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/fp1_tribal_corridor.dds"
	}

	can_be_replaced = yes

	is_enabled = {
		scope:holder = {
			OR = { # Elf Destiny: Ascended Tribal and the Aeluran Order count as tribal here
				government_has_flag = government_is_tribal
				government_has_flag = government_is_advanced_tribal
				government_has_flag = government_is_aeluran_order
			}
		}
	}

	can_construct_potential = {
		scope:holder = {
			OR = { # Elf Destiny: Ascended Tribal and the Aeluran Order count as tribal here
				government_has_flag = government_is_tribal_excluding_wanua
				government_has_flag = government_is_advanced_tribal
				government_has_flag = government_is_aeluran_order
			}
		}
	}

	buildings = {
		warrior_households_1
		armed_clans_1
		hunter_lodgings_1
		war_storage_1
		martial_festivals_1
		fortified_holds_1

}
